decisions: Owner Landfall A3, 2026-10-19: land replaces the B13, B14 and B22 crossings; the Verdant + Ssarathi isle (jadestair, coilmere, suncoil) replaces Spindle Hill and Tollholm and is boat-only, so the B24 causeway and R42's crossing to it are retired and the knob mole becomes a Jadestair jetty; a Whitehorn + Mirrorhold isle (hornmere, whitepeak) is added north.

retireDecks.B13: land replaces it: the filled Saltsound bay joins the islet (A3 strait fills)
retireDecks.B14: land replaces it: the filled B14 strait (A3 strait fills)
retireDecks.B22: land replaces it: the B22 sand bars (A3 strait fills)

cutRoutes.reason: B24 is retired: R42 keeps its strand from the knob onto Jadestair's hill
